question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘The Glassblower’s Breath’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunetra Gupta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sunetra Gupta has written several other novels, including The Glassblower's Breath and A Sin of Colour.
 
• She has received numerous accolades for her work, including the Sahitya Akademi Award.
 
• In addition to her literary achievements, **Gupta is also recognized for her contributions to science, p**articularly in the field of infectious disease research.
 
• Her writing is often praised for its rich, poetic language and deep psychological insight.
